metaDescription: Turn app ideas into interactive iOS and Android screens and flows — validate with investors and internal teams before full development. Newon APP PROTOTYPE.
headline:
Turn an app idea
into a real experience.
lead: We design and build interactive app prototypes with core iOS and Android flows. Before investor meetings, internal reviews, or development kickoff — validate how the idea actually feels when people use it.
overviewTitle:
You have the story.
Not the experience.
overviewBody: App ideas rarely land through slides and wireframes alone. Investors, partners, and internal stakeholders ask to try it — and engineering teams struggle to start without defined screens, flows, and states.

Building a production app from day one costs too much time and money. Figma alone often lacks interaction, transitions, and mobile context. What you need is a prototype where core flows actually work.

APP PROTOTYPE starts by defining app goals and key scenarios. We design iOS and Android screens, user flows, and interactions — then deliver a clickable prototype for sharing, validation, and dev handoff.

scopeTitle: How to think about project complexity.
scopeLead: Not a fixed package. Scope is set by screen count, platform, interaction depth, and integrations.

priceNote: From ₩500,000 is the starting price for APP PROTOTYPE. MVP App and store-ready builds are quoted separately by scope.

faqs.a: It is the starting price for APP PROTOTYPE — typically core screens and 1–2 interactive flows. MVP App and store-ready builds are quoted separately.
The default is a prototype for investor, internal, and pre-dev validation. Store-ready app development is a separate Store-ready scope.

faqs.q: Can you cover both iOS and Android?
faqs.a: Yes. We design for one platform focus or both, depending on project goal. Quote varies by screens and platform count.
Prototype is typically 2–3 weeks; MVP App about 4–6 weeks. Depends on screens, interaction depth, and feedback rounds.
Yes. We can propose MVP, full build, or store-ready scope from the prototype and spec.
Two revision rounds are included. Out-of-scope changes and extra screens affect timeline and quote.

faqs.q: Figma only, or a working prototype?
faqs.a: The focus is an interactive working prototype. UI files and spec docs can be included when needed.
